description: Visual drag-and-drop builder for Angular views (forms, dashboards, and guided flows) stored as JSON and rendered natively.
rules: Element `type` strings are exact lowercase camelCase; never invent casing variants like `datePicker` or `DynamicTable`.
Use `visibleIf` (not `hideIf`) to show or hide an element. It is the native field; `hideIf` is only a legacy input alias.
Expressions use JEXL syntax: `&&`, `||`, `!`, `==`, `!=`, ternary `cond ? a : b`, and functions like `isEmpty()`, `notEmpty()`, `toNumber()`; never `and`/`or`/`iif(...)`.
Validators only allow `type`, `value`, `message`, `condition`, `applyIf`. Never place `expression`, `visibleIf`, `disableIf`, `requireIf`, `readonlyIf`, or `resetIf` inside a validator object.
`table.columnsConfig[*]` entries use `key`, not `name`, or the column will not render.
